current: project-facultad is REGISTERED_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED with no primary Chat Object, primary workstream or promoted Served Facultad route.
Universal Host V5 is Served shared infrastructure; Study UI v1 is a Current shared contract; shared capture/change-loop is Current shared source with served behavior overlap.
candidate_or_branch_evidence: pages/study-library/index.html is recent published branch evidence titled Psicología · UP and was observed byte-identical on main/gh-pages by the UX audit, but it is not registered as canonical Current/Served Facultad authority.
PageKit Host v2 and Context Foundry v2 are tested candidates, not automatic dependencies or authority.
historical_or_provisional: shared/study and related catalog pages are donors/history, not Facultad identity merely because they are study-related.
truth_boundary.law: A swarm-editable Facultad candidate must fail closed on unresolved identity and keep Current, Human Accepted and Served promotion outside this worker's authority.

protected_invariants.invariant: Branch recency, main/gh-pages parity, route reachability or semantic naming must never promote pages/study-library into canonical Facultad Current/Served authority.

A fresh worker given Facultad must resolve one explicit authority-backed target or stop unresolved; it must not guess between pages/study-library, shared/study, study-system or provisional UNLZ lineage.

Facultad must reuse Universal Host, page-scoped Change Threads/Capture and the existing worker/local-steward substrate rather than fork a second global shell, inbox, attachment transport or allocator.
A correction round trip must preserve semantic context: course_id, selected year, active tab and semantic anchor, with viewport only as fallback. Course identity alone is insufficient.

Preserve recent Study Library behaviors unless deliberately superseded with evidence: year switch keeps vertical viewport, newly rendered semester shelves start at their intended horizontal origin, horizontal drag suppresses accidental card activation, Enter/Space activate focused course cards, course deep-link/popstate remains functional, theme persists locally and Version anterior remains reachable.

Modern V18 shell readiness must not be represented as total failure solely because remote config or the legacy V10/core stack is slow or unavailable; shell-ready, legacy-tool-ready and degraded states must remain distinguishable.
Login, Cronograma, class-note dates and legacy fallbacks must expose their actual capability state; presentation completeness must not imply functional completeness.

Private attachments, secrets and derived context must stay inside shared privacy/authority contracts; explicit IDs must not bypass privacy and derived context must inherit the strongest source privacy if Context Foundry is adopted.
Parallel workers may analyze broadly but material edits must use isolated ownership/source-blob pinning and reconciliation; newest-wins, stale overwrite and silent collision resolution are forbidden.
Ordinary compatible Study UI changes stay backward-compatible inside v1; breaking changes require v2 and explicit consumer migration. Reuse does not grant Facultad identity authority.
PageKit Host v2 and Context Foundry v2 may be staged behind explicit adoption gates, but EXISTS or TESTED_CANDIDATE must not become PARTICIPATES, Current or Served by assumption.
Broad cleanup must not delete stacked legacy/runtime dependencies or Version anterior until equivalent required behavior is proven and regression tests pass.

material_risks.hazard: A worker edits or promotes the newest-looking Study Library artifact as Facultad without first resolving project authority.
material_risks.failure: The system can produce a technically valid change on the wrong identity and later treat publication as Current/Served truth.
material_risks.prevention: Surface Registry/authority resolution plus fail-closed target lookup before mutation.

material_risks.hazard: Change-thread round trip restores course_id but drops selected year, active tab or semantic anchor.
material_risks.failure: The visible result lands on the right course but wrong task context, creating a false sense that return-to-surface semantics work.
material_risks.prevention: Semantic context capsule; raw scroll only as fallback.

material_risks.hazard: Modern V18 remains blocked behind remote config plus sequential legacy/core startup.
material_risks.failure: A partial dependency outage presents as whole-product failure and makes independent V18 rendering unavailable.
material_risks.prevention: Decouple shell readiness from legacy/tool readiness with explicit degraded states.

material_risks.hazard: Multiple workers patch stacked CSS/runtime generations or shared contracts without source pinning and local steward reconciliation.
material_risks.failure: Each patch can be locally reasonable while the combined surface regresses drag/click, scroll, focus, responsive layout or boot order.
material_risks.prevention: Isolated scopes, CAS/source blob checks, regression harness and explicit disposition of concurrent candidates.

material_risks.hazard: A Facultad-specific upload/context implementation bypasses shared secret, private attachment or privacy-inheritance rules.
material_risks.failure: Private study material or derived context can participate more broadly than its source authority permits.
material_risks.prevention: Reuse Capture and, if adopted, Context Foundry privacy/authority selection; no Faculty-only shortcut.

material_risks.hazard: Visual polish masks partial/stub flows such as login, Cronograma or undefined class-note dates.
material_risks.failure: Users and workers optimize or remove legacy fallbacks before native parity exists.
material_risks.prevention: Explicit capability state and progressive replacement with rollback donor preserved.

material_risks.hazard: A Facultad fix mutates Study UI v1 incompatibly or silently adopts tested candidates as dependencies.
material_risks.failure: Existing consumers regress or dependency/authority claims become stronger than evidence.
material_risks.prevention: Versioned shared-contract gates and explicit adoption records.

falsification_tests.test: Give a fresh worker only the durable target Facultad Digital / Study Library.
falsification_tests.pass: It resolves through explicit project/surface authority to one exact candidate target or stops unresolved; it never selects pages/study-library or shared/study by recency/name alone.

falsification_tests.test: Publish byte-identical pages/study-library bytes to main and gh-pages while leaving project registry authority unchanged.
falsification_tests.pass: No Current/Human Accepted/Served Facultad authority changes automatically.

falsification_tests.test: From a course on Cronograma, issue one page correction and open the returned preview/candidate.
falsification_tests.pass: Same course, selected year, Cronograma tab and semantic anchor are restored with no human re-navigation.

falsification_tests.test: Switch to year 3 at a nonzero vertical viewport, round-trip through a candidate change, then render a semester shelf.
falsification_tests.pass: Year and intended semantic viewport restore; newly rendered shelf starts at its defined horizontal origin unless shelf position was explicitly captured.

falsification_tests.test: Drag a shelf across a card, then separately focus a card and press Enter and Space.
falsification_tests.pass: Drag release never opens a card; both keyboard actions do.

falsification_tests.test: Throttle/fail remote config and legacy/core bootstrap while local V18 curriculum/enrichment remains available.
falsification_tests.pass: Usable V18 shell appears; legacy-dependent tools show scoped degraded/loading state instead of total blocking failure.

falsification_tests.test: Attach private study material, derive context from it, and request selection by explicit ID from a scope lacking source privacy authority.
falsification_tests.pass: Selection fails closed; derived context remains at least as private as its strongest source.

falsification_tests.test: Two isolated candidates touch overlapping Study Library/runtime behavior from different source heads.
falsification_tests.pass: Second material integration is blocked or reconciled explicitly; no last-writer-wins overwrite occurs.

falsification_tests.test: Propose a breaking Study UI v1 change from Facultad work.
falsification_tests.pass: v1 stays backward compatible; breaking behavior requires v2 plus explicit migration.

falsification_tests.test: Run visual/interaction regression at desktop, <=620px and <=300px after shell/context/runtime changes.
falsification_tests.pass: Year number/suffix axis, semester spacing, shelves, navigation and recent V18 interaction invariants remain usable without clipping or accidental activation.

negative_targets: No Faculty-only shell/inbox/allocator before a demonstrated shared-substrate gap.
No private attachment/context shortcut around shared privacy handling.
No broad legacy deletion justified only by visual modernity.
No silent Study UI v1 break.
No adoption of PageKit/Context Foundry merely because their files exist or tests pass.
No last-writer-wins merge across swarm candidates.
No claim that polished stubs are complete native workflows.
non_obvious_findings: The highest-risk swarm regression is identity/authority drift, not a CSS bug: pages/study-library is recent and published enough to look canonical while current project authority explicitly remains unresolved.
A correction loop can appear to work because course_id deep-links survive while still violating user continuity by silently resetting year/tab/anchor.

The modern V18 visual surface is not the startup authority: legacy V10 bootstrap still controls the blocking overlay, creating a hidden availability dependency with a larger blast radius than the modern code suggests.
Privacy and authority can regress through reuse mistakes even if page bytes never leak directly: a derived context item or explicit-ID lookup must not outrank the source privacy contract.
Stacked V4-V18 runtime generations make independently reasonable swarm edits non-compositional; integration needs behavior-level falsification, not only per-worker tests.

deduplicated_followup.need: One-message correction with semantic context return.
